name: ParkingTicketData

fields.name: ticketNumber
fields.description: Unique identifier for the parking ticket

fields.name: vehicleLicensePlate
fields.description: License plate number of the vehicle that received the ticket

fields.name: violationType
fields.description: Type of parking violation (e.g., expired meter, no parking zone, fire hydrant)

fields.name: fineAmount
fields.description: Monetary fine amount in dollars for the violation

fields.name: issuedDateTime
fields.description: Date and time when the ticket was issued

fields.name: location
fields.description: Street address or GPS coordinates where the violation occurred

fields.name: photoEvidenceUrl
fields.description: URL or file path to photo evidence of the violation

fields.name: ticketStatus
fields.description: Current status of the ticket (e.g., issued, paid, contested, dismissed)

description: Central data model for storing parking ticket records with violation details, vehicle information, and ticket lifecycle status

name: PaymentAppealData

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the payment or appeal record

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the associated parking ticket

fields.name: recordType
fields.description: Type of record: PAYMENT, APPEAL, or NOTIFICATION

fields.name: transactionId
fields.description: Payment transaction ID or appeal submission ID

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Payment amount in currency units

fields.name: paymentMethod
fields.description: Method used for payment (CREDIT_CARD, DEBIT_CARD, CASH, ONLINE)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, COMPLETED, SENT

fields.name: content
fields.description: Citizen statement for appeals or notification message content

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the record was created

description: Manages payment transactions, appeal submissions, and notification logs for parking tickets

relationships.description: Links to the parking ticket this record belongs to
Links to the user who made the payment or appeal

name: UserProfileData

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user profile

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full name of the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: Email address for authentication and notifications

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role type: officer, citizen, or administrator

fields.name: badgeNumber
fields.description: Badge number for parking officers (null for other roles)

fields.name: vehicleRegistrations
fields.description: List of vehicle license plates registered to citizen (empty for other roles)

fields.name: phoneNumber
fields.description: Contact phone number for notifications

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active and can access the system

description: Store user profiles for parking officers, citizens, and administrators with role-based access control

relationships.description: Officers issue tickets, citizens receive tickets
